predecessors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
predecessors.text: Provence inside the Frankish shape of 705-717 (all 131 cells of this row lie inside it)

successors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
successors.text: Provence, inside the Frankish shape again from 724 (all 131 cells)

ledger.x: 710: Cliopatria begins a separate 'Merovingian Empire' row on Provence.
718: Cliopatria relabels the same Provence patch 'Carolingian Empire'.
723: Cliopatria ends the Provence row and its Frankish row takes Provence back in 724.

certainty.note: Provence's frontier with the Umayyads of Septimania and with Burgundy and Italy is unfixed; no treaty or survey line.
